intro.text: A religious cult of Sel known for the fervour of its followers.
A religious cult of Sel, tied to the Jesker faith, which Galladon dismisses as a parody of the true religion.
A religious cult of Sel whose rites include human sacrifice. It grew out of Jesker, though Galladon calls it a perversion with little real tie to that faith.

description.text: When Hrathen first meets Dilaf, he finds the arteth's zeal more like that of a follower of the Mysteries than of a Derethi.
Hrathen remarks how quickly the Mysteries were expelled from the Duladel Republic.
Galladon grieves for his lost Jesker faith and dismisses the Mysteries as a parody of it.
Jesker gives weight to the movements of the heavens, and followers of the Mysteries often gather for their rites when the moon is full.

items.text: Sarene trailed King Iadon from Roial's ball down into the sewers, where she found him and other worshippers killing a young woman in a Jeskeri sacrifice meant to call on the spirits to destroy her. Eondel arrived with guards to protect her, and Iadon was imprisoned.
She learned that Iadon had killed several female palace servants in such rites, asking the spirits to intervene for him.
